history.summary:
Keep class-arrival advice with its supporting route
Supporting advice now includes the correct bus, window and trip action. Opening a hidden route also preserves its map. ETA math and ordering are unchanged. Evidence/checkpoint updated; HEAD preserved.

Keep place search accessible and preserve keyboard focus
Added explicit input/list names, current navigation state and announced search errors. Fixed focus loss after selection and delayed blur closing a reopened editor. Evidence and checkpoints saved; HEAD preserved.

Make feedback errors visible and screenshot actions keyboard accessible
Added named fields, selected priorities, announced status and guarded focus restoration. Evidence and checkpoints saved in ux/ux-03. HEAD preserved; ready for independent review.

Clarify past-trip summaries and preserve refresh focus
Historical context now precedes the graph; weighting details remain expandable. Refresh retains keyboard focus and announces loading/errors. Calculations and samples are unchanged. Evidence saved in ux/ux-04; HEAD preserved.

Keep minimap times attributable to routes and buses
Disambiguated shared route initials, added bus numbers to compact waits, and named keyboard-accessible markers. Tested proposal and evidence saved in ux/ux-05/REPORT.md. HEAD and index preserved.

Restore keyboard focus after closing fullscreen trip maps
Fixed Back and Escape focus restoration across overview, walking and pickup-location maps. Trip data and ETA behavior are unchanged. Evidence saved in ux/ux-06/REPORT.md; HEAD and index preserved.

Attribute trip steps and ride tracking to the correct bus
Expanded details now show the bus and wait used by the journey, with explicit boarding choices and guarded keyboard focus. ETA calculations are unchanged. Evidence saved in ux/ux-06-trip/REPORT.md; HEAD and index preserved.

Preserve map recovery focus and describe filtered buses accurately
Fixed both review findings and added browser regressions. Filtering and ETA behavior remain unchanged. Evidence: ux/ux-07-fix/REPORT.md. HEAD and index preserved.

Preserve keyboard focus when configuring stop alerts
Fixed Escape, arm/cancel focus and accessibility semantics. Evidence and checkpoints saved in ux/ux-08/REPORT.md. HEAD and index preserved; ready for independent review.

Keep get-off prompts current and preserve ride recovery focus
Unavailable position now clears obsolete instructions. Prompt dismissal, ride completion and replanning preserve keyboard focus. Evidence: ux/ux-08-ride/REPORT.md. HEAD and index preserved.

Make saved destinations and recent places usable by keyboard
Fixed selection, rename cancellation, deletion and focus recovery. Mobile and desktop browser checks pass. Evidence: ux/ux-10/REPORT.md. HEAD/index preserved; watcher untouched.

review.summary: No blocking findings. Weather keyboard access and focus recovery independently verified: 123 tests, both typechecks, build and six browser reports passed. Checkout unchanged. Evidence: ux/independent-review-round-18.md.
